title: A new RNN based machine learning model to forecast COVID-19 incidence, enhanced by the use of mobility data from the bike-sharing service in Madrid
summary: Full article evaluates an RNN/LSTM COVID-19 incidence forecast using Madrid bike-sharing mobility data; time-series training/validation and comparisons report increased forecast accuracy with mobility inputs. Bounded historical epidemiological forecasting, not causal evidence that mobility changes infections.
